sentences.text: Case :- Matters Under Article 227 No. - 16330 of 2024

Petitioner :- Smt. Madhu
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 6 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Lalit Kumar Shukla,Sudhanshu Shukla

Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Saurabh Srivastava,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for petitioner and learned AGA for the State.

2. The instant petition has been preferred to direct the learned Court of Judicial Magistrate,
Mathura/concerned court to decide/expedite the Complaint Case No. 759/IX/2020 (Smt. Madhu Vs. Jitendra and others), under Sections 498A, 323, 406, 504, 506, 307 IPC and 3/4 of D.P. Act,
Police Station-Mahila Thana, District-Mathura, within stipulated period of time.
3.

entities.text: Complaint Case No. 759/IX/2020 (Smt. Madhu Vs. Jitendra and others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: On the basis of ordersheet, it is crystal clear that it is the petitioner who is not taking steps in pursuance to several orders passed by learned concerned court through which the bailable warrants have already been issued against respondent nos. 2 to 6 and as such prayer for expedite disposal of Complaint Case No. 759/IX/2020 (Smt. Madhu Vs. Jitendra and others) cannot be exceeded.
